name: io.github.tonyyang0504/bol_com-mcp
description: bol.com (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders, mark_ship

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BOL_COM_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of Retailer API credentials created in the bol Seller Dashboard (Settings > API settings); exchanged at POST https://login.bol.com/token (grant_type=client_credentials, HTTP Basic) for a short-lived (~5 minute) JWT.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BOL_COM_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The matching client secret. The token is cached until expiry (bol blocks clients that request a token for every call).
